newsitem.title: USA: TRINOVA to raise stake in Vickers Systems.
newsitem.headline: TRINOVA to raise stake in Vickers Systems.

text.p: TRINOVA Corp said on Wednesday that Vickers Systems Ltd approved a preferred stock offering to a TRINOVA unit that raises its stake in Vickers to 51 percent from 38 percent.
The investment made by TRINOVA's Vickers Inc unit is valued at $1.2 million, the company said.
Vickers Systems has manufacturing facilities in Bombay and Pune and sales offices in six major cities, employing about 675 people, TRINOVA said.
TRINOVA said the deal reinforces its commitment to penetrate the Indian hydraulics market, which is expected to grow significantly over the next five years.
